{{Top|leg}}
A '''sandsuit''' was a specially designed [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] for desert locations. They were fully sealed against [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] intrusion. [[Planetary commandant|Planetary Commandant]] [[Velpar Raftin]] utilized a sandsuit on the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sevarcos II]].
